description: This file defines interface classes and dependency injection components related to configuration flags in the Cuttlefish project, including feature flag classes and their associated components.

classes.name: SystemImageDirFlag
classes.description: Abstract class representing a configuration flag for system image directory, providing a method to retrieve the Path.

classes.name: ConfigFlag
classes.description: Empty class representing a general configuration flag, inheriting from FlagFeature.

methods.name: Path
methods.description: Pure virtual method to retrieve the path of the system image directory.

methods.name: ConfigFlagComponent
methods.description: Factory function returning a Fruit DI component with SystemImageDirFlag and ConfigFlag dependencies.

methods.name: ConfigFlagPlaceholder
methods.description: Factory function returning a Fruit DI component with only ConfigFlag dependency.
